questions.question: What giant spider guards the secret way into Mordor?
What is the pass with the long stairs into Mordor called?
Whom does Gollum trick Frodo into sending home?
questions.note: Frodo tells Sam to go home. Sam weeps on the stairs.

questions.question: What food does Gollum throw away and blame on Sam?
questions.note: He leaves crumbs on Sam's cloak while he sleeps.

questions.question: Who rescues Frodo from Shelob?
questions.note: He turns back, finds the crumbs, and fights her with Sting and the phial.

questions.question: Why does Sam take the Ring from Frodo?
questions.note: Frodo is only paralyzed by Shelob's sting.

questions.question: Where do Orcs take Frodo after Shelob?
questions.note: Sam follows to get him back.

questions.question: What do the Orcs in the tower fight each other over?
questions.note: The fight leaves only a few for Sam to deal with.

questions.question: What do Frodo and Sam disguise themselves in to cross Mordor?
questions.note: They get swept up in an Orc column and slip away.

questions.question: Complete Sam's line on Mount Doom: 'I can't carry it for you…'
questions.note: He hoists Frodo on his back and climbs.
